title: SQL Injection in Login Form
description: The login form is vulnerable to SQL injection attacks, allowing unauthorized database access.
evidence: Payload ' OR 1=1-- bypassed authentication on /login endpoint.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and input validation. Implement prepared statements.

title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Comments
description: Stored XSS vulnerability in the comments section allows injection of malicious scripts.
remediation: Sanitize user input and implement Content Security Policy headers.

title: Weak Password Policy
description: The application does not enforce minimum password complexity requirements.
remediation: Enforce minimum 12-character passwords with complexity requirements.

title: Missing Security Headers
description: Several security headers are missing from HTTP responses.
evidence: X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Strict-Transport-Security headers absent.
remediation: Add recommended security headers to all responses.

title: Server Version Disclosure
description: The server reveals its version information in HTTP headers.
remediation: Configure server to suppress version disclosure.
